INFO.TITLE: About this application
INFO.PROVIDER_DESCRIPTION: This application is intended for news site commenting services. It allows you to read, write, and like comments in an alternative interface. Logging in with the service provider's account is required for writing and liking.
INFO.STORAGE_DESCRIPTION: The application does not use tracking or marketing cookies. Only necessary data is stored in your browser.
INFO.AUTH_DESCRIPTION: Login and comment processing happen directly on the service providers' servers. Your password and comments are not stored on an intermediary server.
